# momo charts

> momo charts is a free, open-source (Apache 2.0), self-hosted alternative to TradingView-style
> stock charting, for swing and momentum traders. It runs on your own computer (Python,
> FastAPI, plain JavaScript and its own dependency-free chart engine) and gets live prices and
> about 20 years of daily history per stock from the user's own Charles Schwab account
> through the Schwab Trader API. It never places orders.

What it does:

- Daily, weekly, monthly and intraday (1m to 1h, pre- and post-market) stock charts with
  moving averages, VWAP, Bollinger Bands, Keltner Channels, RSI, MACD, ATR, ADR % and a
  relative strength line; drawing tools; split view; Bar Replay; keyboard shortcuts.
- Watchlists with live prices, days to earnings and quarterly EPS and sales growth.
- A screener over every US-listed stock (returns and return ranks, ADR, dollar and relative
  volume, moving averages, highs and lows, earnings, growth), with starter scans and a live
  intraday mode.
- Industry strength, CFTC Commitments of Traders positioning, and server-side price alerts.
- Its own daily-bar database: symbols from Nasdaq's directory, history from Schwab, updated
  after each close with split detection. Fundamentals from SEC EDGAR.

Requirements: Python 3.12, uv, a Schwab brokerage account and a (free) Schwab developer app.
Other data providers can be added as Python modules.

## Docs

- [Website](https://alx-kap.github.io/momo-charts/): overview, live chart demo, install
- [README](https://github.com/alx-kap/momo-charts/blob/main/README.md): features, screenshots,
  setup, how the data works, FAQ
- [Daily bar store](https://github.com/alx-kap/momo-charts/blob/main/src/momo_scan/bars.py):
  how daily history is filled and kept current
- [Schwab provider](https://github.com/alx-kap/momo-charts/blob/main/src/momo_scan/live/schwab.py):
  OAuth sign-in, streaming quotes, price history
- [Live provider interface](https://github.com/alx-kap/momo-charts/blob/main/src/momo_scan/live/base.py):
  what another data vendor needs to implement
- [License](https://github.com/alx-kap/momo-charts/blob/main/LICENSE): Apache 2.0
